pr_title: workload/schemachange: fix and re-enable ALTER FUNCTION
pr_body:
A few fixes were needed:
- Include UDF params when generating ALTER FUNCTION statement.
- Changed an errors.Is call to errors.HasType.
- Avoid only using the public schema when creating functions.

fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/116794
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/119029)

Notably, this issue only occurs in the `public` schema. This may be a red herring if `ALTER FUNCTION SET SCHEMA` never succeeds.

review_comments: oh just thought of something: is it worth to check if our schema exists? i'm thinking about a case where we have selected our descriptors to get `descJSONQuery`, another worker fires off a drop schema, and then we try to create a function with that schema here

i think we're safe from this, we use same transaction to pick the schema name and create the function in that schema, so it's guaranteed that no other transaction will have dropped that schema, thanks to serializable transaction guarantees
oh true - ty for explaining why 🥇
